LET THE POOR BREATHE !!

I mean, The rich have their coins, their private groups. Their pumps and their exits.

But what about us ? 

The ones trading $10 and praying for a 2x?

The ones grinding, building, onboarding friends even when our bags are down ?

We are the many !!

Billions of us. Different countries. Different struggles. The same fight.

From Lagos to Manila, Mumbai to New York, Nairobi to London , the story is the same.

> We work harder.

> We hustle longer.

> And yet, the system keeps us running in circles.

That ends today.

$POORS is The People’s Coin , The Global Underdog Movement.

> No VCs.

> No whale games.

> No insiders holding the strings.

> It's a token for the people, by the people, powered by the people.

> We may be poor in fiat, but we’re rich in something they’ll never have :

1. Numbers, there are billions of us.

2. Creativity, memes, ideas, and culture that can’t be bought.

3. Community, a movement that grows stronger every day.

4. When we unite, we’re not small.

When we move together, we’re unstoppable.

> $POORS is proof that being broke isn’t a weakness it’s our superpower.

> This isn’t just a token.

> This is a voice. A protest. A promise that the future of crypto belongs to all of us , not just the few.

> One token.
> Billions of underdogs.
> One unstoppable movement.
> This is $POORS.
> The People’s Coin.
> The Global Underdog Movement.

Join the $POORS movement with @nexaxyz here :

https://t.co/74OvtKNk62

Remember it's SuiSZN and it's all powered by @nexaxyz
